risk_description: generic uses of 'hermeneutics' unrelated to computation (e.g. legal hermeneutics, biblical hermeneutics)
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume from unrelated legal/theological literature
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'computational' or 'AI' or 'digital'

risk_description: missing non-English foundational hermeneutic theory (Gadamer/Ricoeur originally in German/French)
potential_consequence: foundational theory literature in German/French may be under-retrieved
control_or_mitigation: add TV-C1-009 (German translation candidate) and future French candidate; flag for researcher review before freeze
residual_status: RESIDUAL_HIGH - translation candidates not yet verified
notes: direct consequence of SLR-DEC-02 language scope now being adjudicated

risk_description: missing pre-digital theoretical foundations if a lower date limit is later mis-applied
potential_consequence: classical hermeneutic theory predates computation by decades and could be excluded by an inappropriate cutoff
control_or_mitigation: SLR-DEC-03 (adjudicated APPROVED_WITH_LIMITATIONS) already establishes NO_LOWER_DATE_LIMIT for S1/C1 specifically

risk_description: 'digital history' alone captures purely descriptive digital-collection announcements with no methodological content
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume, high screening burden
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with methodological-transparency, interpretation, or 'computational' terms

risk_description: 'close reading' alone captures the entire field of literary criticism unrelated to computation
potential_consequence: very large false-positive volume from literary-criticism journals
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'distant reading' or 'computational'/'digital' terms
notes: one of the highest-risk bare terms in the entire term registry

risk_description: missing non-English digital-history scholarship (substantial French and German digital-humanities communities exist)
potential_consequence: under-retrieval of continental European DH methodology literature
control_or_mitigation: add language variants per SLR-DEC-02; TV-C2-008 (Dutch) drafted, French/German still needed

risk_description: 'archival terms used only in computer storage contexts' (e.g. 'archive' meaning a compressed file or IT backup)
trigger_term_or_rule: term: archive / archival (bare, especially combined with 'digital')
potential_consequence: false positives from computer-science storage/backup literature
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'colonial', 'historical', or a named colonial institution (VOC/EIC)

risk_description: missing Dutch-language colonial-archive-criticism scholarship — the single most consequential narrowness risk in the entire registry, given VOC archives are predominantly Dutch-language and Dutch historiography is a primary source of relevant critical theory
potential_consequence: the domain most central to this project's own Painan-Indrapura context could be systematically under-retrieved
control_or_mitigation: TV-C3-006/007/008 (Dutch candidates) drafted but two of three flagged REQUIRES_REVIEW or EXCLUDED_AMBIGUOUS_TERM pending verification
notes: flagged as the top remediation priority for Wave B continuation

risk_description: missing archival-silence terminology synonyms (e.g. 'absence', 'erasure', 'gaps in the record') beyond the exact phrase 'archival silence'
trigger_term_or_rule: reliance on TV-C3-001 exact phrase only
potential_consequence: literature using synonymous but differently-worded concepts may be missed
control_or_mitigation: add synonym set as an additional remediation item before SLR-DEC-06 freeze

risk_description: possible mistranslation/calque risk for constructed Dutch/Indonesian terms not yet confirmed as attested scholarly usage (TV-C3-008 'archiefstilte', TV-C3-013 'kekosongan arsip')
potential_consequence: if used without verification, either zero recall (term doesn't exist in the literature) or false results (term means something unintended)
control_or_mitigation: require native-speaker or domain-expert verification before either term is promoted out of REQUIRES_REVIEW/EXCLUDED_AMBIGUOUS_TERM status

risk_description: 'event extraction' alone is a generic NLP term with a large non-historical literature (e.g. news event extraction, biomedical event extraction)
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume from unrelated NLP application domains
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'historical' or 'archival' or 'historical corpus'

risk_description: missing provenance/uncertainty synonym terms (e.g. 'confidence scoring', 'source attribution', 'evidence linking') beyond the specific phrases already drafted
trigger_term_or_rule: reliance on TV-C4-003/004/006 exact phrases only
potential_consequence: adjacent methodological literature using different terminology for the same concept may be missed
control_or_mitigation: add synonym set as an additional remediation item before SLR-DEC-06 freeze

risk_description: 'interval censoring' alone is dominated by a large biostatistics/medical/survival-analysis literature unrelated to historical event modeling
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume from clinical/epidemiological literature
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'historical', 'event', or 'temporal point process' terms
residual_status: RESIDUAL_MODERATE-HIGH - biostatistics literature is very large
notes: highest-volume broadness risk identified across all six families

risk_description: 'simulation' (within 'simulation recovery') is used across many unrelated computational fields (physics, engineering, economics simulations generally)
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'identifiability', 'point process', or 'Hawkes'

risk_description: missing coarse-time/tied-event terminology synonyms beyond the specific phrases already drafted (e.g. 'discretized time', 'binned event data', 'annual resolution')
trigger_term_or_rule: reliance on TV-C5-004/005/009 exact phrases only
potential_consequence: adjacent statistical literature on coarse-time methods using different phrasing may be missed
control_or_mitigation: add synonym set as an additional remediation item before SLR-DEC-06 freeze

risk_description: this family is the direct Hawkes-relevance-gate family (H_i^relevant, protocol Sec.17); an overly broad OR-chain risks flooding extraction with statistically-relevant-but-historically-irrelevant papers, while an overly narrow one risks missing a genuine negative-result/identifiability-failure paper directly informative for Model 3B V2
trigger_term_or_rule: the full C5 boolean template as currently drafted
potential_consequence: either extraction-stage overload or missing a directly load-bearing methodological paper for the project's own closed V1 Hawkes finding
control_or_mitigation: apply the nine-feature Hawkes relevance gate (protocol Sec.17) at full-text/extraction stage as the actual filter, not the search string alone - the search string's job is recall, not precision
residual_status: RESIDUAL_MODERATE, by design (relevance gate is meant to do the precision work downstream)
notes: most epistemically consequential family given its direct link to Model 3B V2 decision-making

risk_description: 'game theory' alone is an enormous economics/mathematics literature with no historical-humanities application
potential_consequence: extremely large false-positive volume, likely the single largest breadth risk in the entire registry
control_or_mitigation: never search 'game theory' alone; always AND with 'history'/'historical' per protocol Sec.6 boolean template (already documented, but must be enforced strictly in the frozen string)
residual_status: RESIDUAL_HIGH if the AND-constraint is ever relaxed; LOW if strictly enforced
notes: single highest-volume breadth risk identified across the entire term registry

risk_description: 'network' alone (within 'historical network analysis') captures the vast general social-network-analysis and computer-networking literatures
potential_consequence: large false-positive volume from unrelated CS/social-science literature
control_or_mitigation: require co-occurrence with 'historical' and ideally 'actor' or 'relation'

risk_description: missing Dutch-language historiography on VOC-era alliances/strategic interaction, and missing Indonesian-language historiography on power relations in the same period
trigger_term_or_rule: English-only term set for the historically-specific core of this domain
potential_consequence: the literature most likely to directly inform this project's own Atlas power-relations and game-theory work could be under-retrieved
control_or_mitigation: TV-C6-008 (Dutch) and TV-C6-009 (Indonesian) drafted, both flagged REQUIRES_REVIEW pending verification

risk_description: 'payoff provenance' (TV-C6-005) may be a project-internal coined phrase rather than an attested term in the external literature, risking near-zero recall if used as a primary search term
potential_consequence: near-zero recall if the phrase is not actually used in the target literature
control_or_mitigation: use as a secondary/diagnostic term only; rely primarily on broader established terms ('payoff assumptions', 'payoff structure', 'equilibrium claim') for actual retrieval
